arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Streett argued fee defense is part of reasonable compensation.
Mr. Oldham argued Section 330(a) compensates all professional services.
Mr. Fletcher agreed that successful fee defense may increase awards.
Justice Sotomayor questioned if accountants can pay legal fees.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests whether bankruptcy professionals may bill for defending their fee applications. The lower court denied these fees. Baker Botts asks the Supreme Court to reverse that denial. ASARCO asks the Court to affirm the denial.
